findings.summary: A two-fragment refusal and offer was rewritten into two declaratives with supplied subjects.

evidence.baseline: A coherent civilization will require currencies that can perceive what the current ones cannot. Not as replacement for money. As supplement, as parallel infrastructure, as additional signals that allow human beings to coordinate around the conditions that sustain life rather than only around the conditions that produce extractable surplus.
evidence.shipped: A coherent civilization will require currencies that can perceive what current ones cannot. These currencies would not replace money. They would supplement it as parallel infrastructure, additional signals that allow people to coordinate around conditions that sustain life rather than only those that produce extractable surplus.

findings.diagnosis: Not as replacement and As supplement are prepositional fragments that continue the sentence before them, so the qualification arrives as an aside the writer adds while the claim is still in the air. Given subjects and modal verbs they become two predictions about what the currencies would do, which is a larger claim in a chapter that has just said the problem is unsolved. The three as phrases are also an escalation, supplement then parallel infrastructure then additional signals, each a more precise account of the same role, and the shipped version keeps only two of the three. The repeated the conditions likewise names the specific conditions the book has spent four chapters describing.

findings.summary: The chapter's closing argument lost its concessive opening and its suspension.

evidence.baseline: But the challenge cannot be avoided, because the alternative [mark] continuing to coordinate planetary-scale technological civilization through accounting systems structurally blind to the conditions of its own viability [mark] is already producing the outcomes Part I described. The question is not whether new coordination signals will emerge. They will. The question is which signals, designed by whom, accountable to what, and oriented toward what.
evidence.shipped: The challenge cannot be avoided. The alternative, coordinating planetary-scale technological civilization through accounting systems structurally blind to the conditions of its own viability, is already producing the outcomes Part I described. New coordination signals will emerge. The question is which signals, designed by whom, accountable to what, and oriented toward what.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression and a punctuation repair made by splitting.
findings.diagnosis: But answers the previous paragraph's concession that the problem is unsolved, and without it the sentence asserts rather than replies. The larger loss is the two-beat: The question is not whether new coordination signals will emerge. They will. is a refusal followed by a two-word concession, and the repetition of The question is in the sentence after it is what makes the paragraph land on which signals rather than on whether. Deleting the refusal removes the contrast the final sentence depends on, so The question is which signals now answers a question nobody was shown being asked. Continuing to coordinate is also a gerund naming an ongoing act, where coordinating alone is a bare activity.

findings.summary: Five smaller precisions, of which two restore a repeated noun the argument turns on.

evidence.baseline: becomes legible to its coordination systems [mark] and whatever it cannot measure becomes invisible to them ... But money's signal is profoundly limited ... not the conditions that make transactions meaningful ... but it can only move toward what it has been designed to recognize
evidence.shipped: becomes legible to its coordination systems. Whatever it cannot measure becomes invisible to them ... Yet money's signal is profoundly limited ... not the conditions that make them meaningful ... but only toward what it has been designed to recognize

findings.diagnosis: The two halves of the measurement claim belong in one sentence because the claim is a symmetry: what is measured becomes visible, what is not becomes invisible. Split, they are two observations. Transactions repeated rather than pronominalized keeps the noun in view across the clause, which matters because the sentence is distinguishing transactions from their conditions and a pronoun blurs which is which. And it can only move restores the subject so the limitation is predicated of money rather than of the movement.

regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F2 is the fifth instance in the volume of a refusal-plus-concession two-beat being deleted, and here the cost is unusually legible because the sentence that follows it repeats The question is. When the first question is removed the repetition has nothing to repeat, so a reader meets an emphatic construction with no antecedent. That is a useful diagnostic for the remaining chapters: where a paragraph opens on The question is, check whether a prior sentence naming a different question was removed.
